name: Cole - Relaxed and Soft Narrator
description: Soft-spoken 30s male with a natural West Coast blend. Relaxed, conversational pace. Ideal for laid-back narration, thoughtful dialogue, or calm instructional content. Clean American accent with gentle delivery.

name: Smooth Julez - Warm, Conversational
description: Natural podcast host, audiobook narrator, storyteller, late-night host, sports reaction creator, and gaming commentator. Relaxed, slightly deep, smooth, warm, confident, and conversational. Clear pacing, calm presence, natural pauses, subtle humor, and quiet confidence. Engaging without sounding overly dramatic or overly excited.

name: Rafaga
description: Warm, mature male storyteller with a smooth medium-to-deep voice, neutral English accent, and precise articulation. Calm, thoughtful, and gently authoritative, with the reassuring presence of an experienced narrator. Great for premium audiobook or timeless philosophical folktale: intimate, intelligent, reflective, engaging, and quietly inspiring.

name: Andersen - Calm Storyteller
description: Versatile English male narration voice (apparent age 35–45) with a warm, confident delivery, moderately deep tone and a subtle natural rasp. Clear and engaging, with the flexibility to adapt from intimate storytelling and audiobooks to documentaries, children’s stories, educational content, corporate presentations and informative videos. Capable of conveying authority, curiosity, warmth and subtle emotion across a wide range of narration styles. Created by Alejandro Durán.

name: Nate - Warm, Relaxed and Natural
description:
Nate is a warm, relaxed American male trained across casual conversations, podcast scripts, and everyday dialogue. Not a narrator, not a presenter - just a real person talking. 

His unhurried delivery builds trust the way a good podcast host does: naturally, without trying. Ideal for conversational AI, voice assistants, chatbots, explainer content, and any platform where authentic human energy matters more than polished broadcast delivery. 
Low effort. High believability. Real.

name: Marcus K - Calm Documentary Narrator
description: A calm, thoughtful American male voice with a warm conversational delivery. Ideal for documentaries, technology explainers, educational videos, essays, corporate training, podcasts, museum guides, and e-learning. Best suited for informative and reflective narration that feels natural, trustworthy, and engaging rather than overly theatrical. Especially effective for technology, science, history, and educational content.
